behavior: A popup can complete an open change while `KeepAlive` holds its popup part, even when the part first mounts in the held branch. Dialog, Alert Dialog and Drawer have no positioner and need no backdrop part for this. The root can wait on the held popup element. It has no CSS animation outside the document, so the wait ends after one frame. The root emits `openChangeComplete` before activation. After a close it unmounts the popup, or hides it if the family or consumer keeps it. Thus no exit plays at activation. Base UI waits in a React effect. React destroys the effects of a hidden `Activity` and restores them at reveal, so a root inside it completes its close after reveal.
